title: The Memory Keeper
author: Barış Kısır
premise: The Memory Keeper of the title is the family\'s archivist: every photograph, every letter, every receipt of the Lindquist family, kept in a house that has held them for five generations. When the keeper, Ruth, dies, her granddaughter Maren inherits the archive — and discovers the family\'s history has been curated: some memories kept, others deliberately lost. To keep the archive honestly, Maren must find what Ruth removed.
